integrity: The standalone exact-integer arithmetic program is included; no numerical rounding is used in the exhaustive search. The relative-volume calculation uses documented classical polyhedral geometry.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the standard Euclidean rhombic triacontahedron only. A complete exact 35,960-subset enumeration proves the finite vertex extremum, and a separate multiaffine argument establishes global rigidity. Unindexed bibliographic overlap cannot be excluded.
title: The twenty largest tetrahedra in the rhombic triacontahedron
